# Changelog

A version change log for downstream developers: it records only user-facing impact (new capabilities, behavior changes, whether code/config changes are needed), not internal implementation details. Listed newest first; the `Unreleased` section is appended to in real time by feature/fix MRs, and archived into a formal version section and removed at release time (the section exists only during development and is re-created by the next feature/fix MR after archiving).

## 1.1.2 - 2026-08-31

- New: local video recording and playback — the camera page consolidates into a "Photo / Video" segmented switch with a fixed central shutter (a red dot and second-level duration show in the title bar while recording); the shared MJPEG camera stream records to local AVI (with a PCM audio track when the microphone is available, 110 seconds max per clip, saved to the SD card); App Center gains a Video list (card list + immersive player, with select/select-all/async batch delete). Requires `ENABLE_TY_AVI_MEDIA` and `UI_FEATURE_VIDEO`.
- Optimization: recording and playback robustness — recording is capped at 15fps and muxed by actual capture timestamps, with automatic frame-rate reduction and a safe stop (plus a storage-error prompt) on slow or failing storage; playback starts its media clock only after the first frame and audio output are ready, rebuilds the A/V timeline on pause/resume, and clearly reports errors for truncated or corrupted AVI files; video, AI playback, and P2P calls now share the speaker through owner arbitration, avoiding mixed PCM writes and mistakenly powering off the amplifier.
- Fix: the camera could go permanently black after hanging up a P2P call — when switching back from H264 to JPEG fails, the mode switch now retries and rolls back automatically, and even on persistent failure it self-heals on the next mode switch; no reboot needed anymore.
- Change: board support — the XY4100LC board is removed; L511_Y7PM gains release-ready configuration and LCD TEF animation rendering.

## 1.1.0 - 2026-08-14

- New: a brand-new UI framework and full set of screens — a Vue-inspired responsive LVGL framework (state store / page routing / tick driver) built from scratch, delivering all pages (home, AI chat, app center, settings, album, music, recording, clock, contacts, and more) with runtime-switchable Chinese/English (framework overview in `src/ui/README.md`, development constraints in `src/ui/RULES.md`).
- New: UI feature-cluster trimming and board-level customization — `UI_FEATURE_*` Kconfig switches trim pages/services per feature cluster (disabled items link gracefully via fallback stubs), and boards can register their own UI to replace the standard wukong pages.
- New: the TEF animation pipeline fully replaces GIF — an in-house TEF format and encoding toolchain (including `--stabilize` temporal denoising) covering three playback modes (emotions pushed straight to GRAM, boot splash, and the `lv_tef` page widget), saving ~1.1MB flash with decode CPU down to ~1/6 (usage: [TEF animations](docs/en/howto/use-tef-animation.md)).
- New: EYES dual-screen board support — two st7735s panels stitched into one logical display, TEF emotions pushed to both panels in parallel, with a driver refresh-direction fix that markedly reduces the dual-screen tearing effect.
- Optimization: audio playback stability and diagnostics — streaming-TTS pre-buffering removes network-jitter micro-stutters, continuous music stutter during camera preview is fixed (playback thread priority), AP-STAT playback diagnostics gain a runtime switch, and player configuration is consolidated into a dedicated "Audio Player" menu (how to read the stats: [Playback Stutter Troubleshooting](docs/en/troubleshooting/audio-playback-stutter.md)).
- Refactor: the audio driver stack is unified onto tal_audio — recording, calls, factory test, and stream capture all migrate off tkl_audio, with a new capability to capture the 5 uplink audio streams to SD card for analysis (see [Capturing the 5 Uplink Audio Streams](docs/en/troubleshooting/audio-stream-capture.md)).
- New: external storage unified into the `wukong_storage` layer — the medium (SD card / external QSPI flash / none) is a compile-time choice with a single app-wide asynchronous mount at boot; the former store record layer is merged in, with fully compatible paths and byte formats — no OTA migration needed (integration guide: `src/wukong/storage/README.md`).
- New: a full P2P call upgrade — the P2P business component is replaced (the three-layer TMM stack), adding device↔device voice calls, a contacts page with NFC tap-to-add friends, and incoming calls now ring for manual answering by default (security compliance).
- New: first-boot activation wizard — an unactivated device automatically enters the language → activation method → QR-code activation flow on boot, with manual Wi-Fi connection on the WLAN page (on-screen keyboard) and on-screen QR-code direct pairing/activation.
- New: on-site diagnostics — the app center gains a Diagnostics page collecting system status (memory / uptime / reset reason), network diagnostics (WiFi/IP/RSSI/cloud link), screen test (solids / color bars / touch drawing), audio diagnostics, playback stats, and the FPS overlay, so field issues no longer require a serial hookup.
- Fix: after barging in during voice playback, the new reply text was appended into the previous AI message — interrupted replies now always start a new message, covering both cloud-side and device-side interruption paths.
- Optimization: time-management experience — the clock page unifies the visual hierarchy of its alarm/countdown/stopwatch/Pomodoro tabs, the pulldown panel gains a timer card grid showing live run states with direct jumps to the matching tab, and the status bar updates alarms/reminders in real time.
- Optimization: camera pipeline rework — viewfinder refactor, preview/full-image downsampling, a photo-result callback, and a camera-capability check for detection mode.
- Optimization: recording improvements — SD writes decoupled to prevent frame loss, second-level playback progress with hh:mm:ss duration, newest-first list ordering, paginated transcription results, and lazy-MD5 power-loss recovery for faster boot.
- Optimization: boot experience — the boot splash appears ~1 second earlier (LCD → splash → TP init reordering, non-blocking TP init), and the splash animation migrates to TEF and slims down.
- Optimization: firmware footprint — the BSS rework reclaims ~34.7KB SRAM (static buffers made on-demand or moved out of BSS), the Chinese font is trimmed to tier-1 common characters plus Montserrat glyph subsets for ~435KB flash saved in total, and the UI thread stack size moves into menuconfig.
- New: ultra-low-power ULTRA_SLEEP mode (AP stays alive long-term).
- New: master display switch `ENABLE_TUYA_DISPLAY` — the LCD/TP driver stack and display message bus compile independently of the UI framework; with display on and UI off, the business side still reports emotions/chat states for board-specific rendering to consume.
- New: System Update (OTA) screen — Settings → About gains a System Update entry; check for updates manually (showing the target version, package size, and release notes) and confirm the upgrade; when OTA starts the screen opens automatically with a progress bar and phase messaging, you can leave during download and keep following progress from the pulldown panel, the screen locks during verify/install, and the device restarts automatically on completion.
- Optimization: OTA compression upgrade is enabled by default.
- Docs: `docs/` restructured into a task-oriented system — a howto series (board porting / AI skills / wake word / dialogue modes / MCP tools / UI customization / TEF animations / [factory test](docs/en/howto/factory-test.md) / [connecting a UART offline voice chip](docs/en/howto/connect-uart-voice-chip.md), etc.) + a troubleshooting series + the module reference index + resource statistics, all bilingual with a hard-check script.
